# `usaspending_awards`

**USAspending selected awards**

One selected archive and native award, with selected-year transaction obligations and separately stated lifetime award totals.

**Coverage.** Sampled. Explicit selected full agency/year/family snapshots only. Local qualification and publication are separate. Never combine full snapshots or append an all-year delta. Contracts, funding rows, subawards and unselected agencies/years are outside the first qualified Denali FY2025 assistance cohort. See docs/usaspending-awards.md. *(measured 2026-11-13)*

- **Parquet file:** `usaspending_awards.parquet`
- **MCP `query_sql` support:** Configured; requires an available artifact.
- **Publication status:** Not established by this schema page or its measurement date.
- **Row count:** Not stated here; the MCP `describe_table` reply gives the live count under `publication`.

| Column | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `archive_sha256` | `VARCHAR` | SHA-256 of the retained original ZIP; join and filter on this snapshot identity before comparing revisions. |
| `archive_url` | `VARCHAR` | Publisher-advertised URL for the exact retained archive. A live URL alone does not establish unchanged bytes. |
| `archive_version` | `VARCHAR` | Literal publisher updated_date from the retained monthly inventory; separate from member spelling and capture time. |
| `award_family` | `VARCHAR` | Explicitly selected assistance or contracts; these families remain separate. |
| `fiscal_year` | `INTEGER` | Selected action-date fiscal year, beginning October 1 of the preceding calendar year. |
| `awarding_agency_code` | `VARCHAR` | Native Treasury agency code, checked on every transaction; differs from the inventory database ID. |
| `award_key` | `VARCHAR` | Native award unique key; one award can have several transactions. |
| `selected_transaction_count` | `BIGINT` | Transactions belonging to this award in the selected fiscal-year archive; not the lifetime transaction count. |
| `selected_fy_obligations` | `DECIMAL(38,2)` | Sum of contributing selected transaction obligations in exact USD. Includes signed adjustments; separate from lifetime award totals and outlays. |
| `publisher_overall_award_obligated_amount` | `DECIMAL(38,2)` | Publisher overall-award obligation, in exact USD, spanning the award lifetime. Repeated on transaction rows; sum only once per archive and award in usaspending_awards. Blank is unknown. |
| `publisher_overall_award_outlayed_amount` | `DECIMAL(38,2)` | Publisher overall-award outlay, in exact USD, spanning the award lifetime. Repeated on transaction rows; sum only once per archive and award in usaspending_awards. It is not a fiscal-year or transaction outlay. Blank is unknown. |
| `first_selected_action_date` | `DATE` | Earliest contributing selected transaction action date; not necessarily award inception. |
| `last_selected_action_date` | `DATE` | Latest contributing selected transaction action date; not necessarily the lifetime latest action. |
